articles.title: The Strait of Hormuz: A Water Highway That's Causing Big Trouble
articles.summary: The U.S. and Iran are fighting over a waterway called the Strait of Hormuz. Iran closed it, but the U.S. has now helped other countries send more oil through. Gas prices are high, and the war is still going.

articles.title: A Record-Breaking Parasite Outbreak Is Over, But Where Did It Come From?
articles.summary: A tiny parasite called cyclospora made nearly 20,000 people sick in the U.S. this year — way more than usual. The outbreak is over, but scientists still don't know exactly how it started.

articles.title: The CDC and the Measles Mystery: Why Some Doctors Are Worried
articles.summary: Measles is spreading in the U.S. more than it has in many years. When two kids died in Pennsylvania, the CDC took the deaths off its website. Now some doctors say they're worried about trusting the CDC's health information.
